stage1.impression: A moody, warm, misty pine wood with a glowing burn pile, and the speaker standing in the same air; the mood is right and the ground and light shafts are the most convincing part. But the haze has bleached the top half into a flat cream wash, the 'smoke' reads as morning fog rather than woodsmoke (no plume, no structure), the fire is a salmon blob on a blocky log stack, and the speaker reads as a muddy brown box with a blotchy, dirty-looking horn. Competent CG, not yet a photograph.

blocking_9: Woodsmoke must read as smoke: a visible rising, drifting plume with structure from the burn pile, not a uniform cream fog
Upper half must hold tonal separation: trunks clearly darker than the air behind them, sky band not a flat 200+ wash
The fire must read as a smouldering burn pile: small hot ember points and a deep orange glow, not a pink/salmon cast on the haze
The speaker's tint must read as smoked black acrylic, not warm brown, while staying veiled
The horn must be free of blotchy low-frequency noise/denoiser smear
The trunks must read as real pines (bark relief, root flare, varied girth/lean), not smooth cylinders
Burn-pile logs must read as charred wood with real form, not stacked boxes

defects.what: Haze washes the upper frame to a flat cream (median 183, sky band 600-1000 x 0-400 median 204); little depth separation between near and far trunks
No visible smoke plume rising from the burn pile; the smoke has no shape, only uniform fog
Fire glow is a pink/salmon cast (r208 g136 b102) on haze and a trunk; ember points are dull (p95 189), logs are blocky, untextured shapes
Speaker body reads warm brown (RGB 76/58/47, dE2000 8.2 vs #3A3634 smoked grey-black), dull and murky; warm kicker/bounce dominate
Horn top surface is mottled with blotchy dark patches, reads as dirt/rust or denoiser smear of volumetric noise
Left edge of the body has an orange glowing rim that reads as an emissive strip rather than reflected light
Trunks are smooth uniform cylinders, no bark relief visible, no root flare into the ground
Out-of-focus foreground trunk at right is a soft featureless column
Foreground ground is a uniform fine gravel-like texture; leaf litter does not read as pine forest floor (no needles, cones)
The pile's base fades into flat haze with no ground interaction (no ash glow on the ground around it)

changes.problem: The uniform haze and between-trunk smoke flatten the whole upper frame into a cream wash, killing depth and contrast.

evidence.measured: lum_median 204.4, p95 227; whole top band [0,0,1200,400] median 183; trunk at [650,0,720,400] median 141 only ~60 below the air

change.setting: Smoke: uniform haze; Smoke: between the trunks
change.to: uniform 0.006; between trunks 0.09, with noise scale raised so it breaks into banks rather than an even fill

changes.expected: Sky band drops to median 160-185, trunks separate from the air by 80+ levels, three readable depth planes of trunks

changes.problem: There is no visible smoke plume, so the frame reads as fog, not 'Where there's smoke'.

evidence.measured: lum_range 74 with p5 137: no darker smoke structure above the pile, just haze and one trunk

change.to: density 3.0 falling 0.9/cell, #A8A39C (grey, darker than the backlit air), cool fill 10; lean the column up-left through the sun shafts so it is backlit at the edges

changes.expected: A distinct grey column with soft billowing edges rising from the pile and drifting left above the speaker, darker than the air behind it

changes.problem: The fire reads as a salmon-pink glow and the ember points are too dim to read as fire.

evidence.measured: r208 g136 b102 (pinkish), lum_p95 189: no hot points

change.setting: Burn pile: ember point light, upward glow, ember chips
change.from: 250 W ember point, 150 W upward glow, ember chip emission as is
change.to: ember point 140 W #FF5A14, upward glow 90 W #FF6A20, ember chip emission x3 so the brightest chips approach white-orange; replace box logs with charred cylindrical logs with cracked char texture

changes.expected: Deep orange glow localized at the pile, a few small near-clipping ember points, no pink wash across the haze

changes.problem: The speaker's smoked black acrylic reads as muddy warm brown.

change.setting: Speaker lights: warm kicker; bounce; sky fill
change.to: kicker 55 #FFB978 (spread wider so it does not draw a hard orange strip on the left edge); bounce 8 #B4AEA6; sky fill 3.0 #B8BCC0

changes.expected: Body reads as a veiled smoked grey-black with warm edges, the lining and woofer still visible through the tint

changes.problem: The horn is covered in low-frequency blotches that read as dirt or denoiser smear of the volume noise behind it.

evidence.measured: lum_range 26 in a flat area of the horn that should be smooth; visible mottling at 4x crop

change.to: 512 samples for the final, volume step rate 0.5, denoiser with albedo+normal passes; keep wisp volumes from intersecting the horn

changes.expected: Smooth, even tint across the horn with only the real gradient of the light

changes.problem: The modelled trunks are smooth uniform cylinders with no bark relief or root flare.

evidence.measured: lum_range 75 almost all from the vertical light gradient; no bark texture visible at 1x

change.to: displaced pine_bark (bark plates 2-3 cm relief), girth varied 0.25-0.6 m, 1-3 deg lean, root flare into the litter, a few dead branch stubs

changes.expected: Near trunks show bark relief in the side light; trunks sit in the ground instead of standing on it

changes.problem: The forest floor reads as a fine uniform gravel, not a pine wood floor.

evidence.measured: lum_median 69, uniform fine-grain texture across the whole band; no needles or cones seen in the crop

change.to: add a scattered pine-needle and cone layer (particle scatter, 3-6 cones per m2 near camera), a few patches of ash drifting from the pile, keep the five branches but put one in the left foreground out of focus

changes.expected: The floor reads as pine litter with scale cues; foreground gains a soft out-of-focus element that frames the speaker

changes.problem: Overall tonality is soft; after the haze is reduced the image still needs a touch more depth and ember glow.

evidence.measured: lum_p1 48, p99 227: no true darks or highlights anywhere

changes.expected: Darkest tones near 25-35 in the foreground shadow, embers bloom slightly

out_of_scope.request: None of the speaker's own shape, colour or parts needs changing; its brown appearance is a lighting problem (c4).
out_of_scope.why: The speaker is fixed by the card
